facts.fact: Egyptian fintech Blnk raised a US$12.5m Series A equity round led by Algebra Ventures, with SANAD Fund for MSME, Endeavor Catalyst and existing investor Emirates International Investment Company; the document does not give the investors' home countries and is dated 2026-06-08.

Blnk secured US$24.6m in local-currency debt facilities from banks and non-bank financial institutions including National Bank of Egypt, Suez Canal Bank and Bank Al Baraka Egypt, all lenders operating in Egypt; the document is dated 2026-06-08.

Blnk raised US$24.6m in local-currency debt from Egyptian banks and non-bank financial institutions, including National Bank of Egypt, Suez Canal Bank and Bank Al Baraka Egypt; the document is dated 2026-06-08.
